name: Storm
summary: Worshipped as a goddess before she ever joined a team. Ororo Munroe commands wind, rain and lightning, and she has led the X-Men through some of their hardest years.
origin: Storm walked into comics already being worshipped as a goddess, and she has carried herself like royalty ever since. Len Wein and Dave Cockrum introduced Ororo Munroe in Giant-Size X-Men #1 in 1975, when Professor X found her in Kenya, where villagers revered her for bringing rain. Her past turned out to be rough: orphaned in Cairo, she grew up as a street thief before heading south. She comes from a line of African priestesses with white hair and blue eyes, and her mutant gift lets her command weather, from gentle breezes to hurricanes and lightning. She has led the X-Men, married a king and ruled a mutant society on Mars. Not bad for a former pickpocket.
powers: Shrugs off extreme cold, heat and pressure

storyline.title: Weather goddess
storyline.beat: Ororo Munroe, worshipped as a goddess in Kenya for her weather powers, is recruited by Professor X in Giant-Size X-Men #1.

storyline.title: Taking command
storyline.beat: When Cyclops leaves after Jean Grey's death, Storm becomes leader of the X-Men.

storyline.title: The mohawk
storyline.beat: Storm swaps her flowing look for a leather outfit and a mohawk, a bold change that fans still love.

storyline.title: Winning without powers
storyline.beat: Storm loses her powers to a weapon built by Forge. While still powerless she beats Cyclops in a duel for leadership of the X-Men.

storyline.title: Queen of Wakanda
storyline.beat: Storm marries her childhood friend T'Challa, the Black Panther, and becomes queen of Wakanda for a time.

storyline.title: Regent of Mars
storyline.beat: During the Krakoa era Storm becomes the ruler of Arakko, a mutant society settled on Mars.

gossip.text: She beat Cyclops in a fight for X-Men leadership while she had no powers at all.
She is claustrophobic, the result of being trapped under rubble as a child in Cairo.
Before joining the X-Men she survived as a child pickpocket on the streets of Cairo.
Halle Berry played her in the first X-Men films, and Alexandra Shipp took over the role later.
Later stories added that Storm and T'Challa first met as kids, when she helped rescue him. None of that was in her original 1970s appearances.

quiz.q: Where did Storm make her debut?

theme.tagline: Bad weather is a choice. Hers.

timeline.title: Weather goddess
timeline.note: Giant-Size X-Men #1 introduces Ororo, a woman worshipped in Kenya, recruited into the new X-Men.

timeline.title: Taking command
timeline.note: Uncanny X-Men #139 makes Storm the team's field leader, with Cyclops off on leave.

timeline.title: The mohawk
timeline.note: Uncanny X-Men #173 debuts Storm's punk look, a bold change for a character known for her grace.

timeline.title: Winning without powers
timeline.note: Uncanny X-Men #201 has a powerless Storm beat Cyclops in a duel for leadership of the team.

timeline.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
timeline.note: The Fox Kids cartoon makes Storm a fan favorite, with dramatic speeches as she summons the weather.

timeline.title: Halle Berry in X-Men
timeline.note: Bryan Singer's X-Men film casts Halle Berry as Ororo, a role she played across four films.

timeline.title: Queen of Wakanda
timeline.note: Black Panther #18 holds Storm's wedding to T'Challa, making her a queen.

timeline.title: Starring in X-Men '97
timeline.note: The X-Men '97 revival gives Storm a standout arc about losing and reclaiming her powers.
